subject: StreamlinePay launch: temporary SLA tightening & augmented on-call proposal
messages:
From: Eleanor James <eleanor.james@streamlinepay.com>
To: support@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-10T09:14:00+01:00
Subject: Upcoming EU go-live — ask about response SLA for launch weekend

Hi Redwood support team,

We go live in production across the EU on Friday 2026-05-21 and expect a large spike in API traffic as several merchants cut over. Given the criticality, we need confirmation you can guarantee P1 responses within 15 minutes and P2 within 2 hours for the 72-hour launch window (Fri 00:00–Sun 23:59 UTC+1).

Our internal ops will be staffed but we'd like Redwood to temporarily tighten the SLA for that window and provide an explicit on-call escalation path (including an ops cell contact) and immediate notification channel for incidents that degrade availability or increase latency beyond agreed bands.

Can you confirm feasibility, cost/credit terms for the exception, and the escalation roster by EOD Monday?

Thanks,
Eleanor
Eleanor James
Head of Platform Reliability
StreamlinePay

(attachment: launch-readiness-checklist.pdf, application/pdf)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor James <eleanor.james@streamlinepay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T11:02:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming EU go-live — ask about response SLA for launch weekend

Hi Eleanor — thanks for the heads up and the checklist.

Short answer: we can operationalize a temporary tightening but need to align on scope and compensation. Operational notes below and a proposed plan attached.

What we need from StreamlinePay to finalize:
- Expected request qps and peak TPS per region during the window
- Any scheduled schema or model changes during cutover
- Primary contact + secondary for immediate 3-way comms during incidents

Our proposed execution (high level):
1) Temporary SLA change for 72-hour window: P1 = 15 minutes escalation acknowledgment, P2 = 2 hours acknowledgment (we'll define "acknowledgment" vs "full resolution" in the amendment).
2) Augmented on-call: assign a dedicated weekend ops cell (2 SREs + 1 tech lead) with an on-call escalation to a rotation of two senior engineers.
3) Notification path: PagerDuty + dedicated Slack channel + SMS for the ops cell lead.
4) Credits: we can offer a defined support premium or alternatively credits if SLA is missed; I'll surface commercial options from sales in parallel.

Attaching: proposed on-call roster and operational runbook.

I'll loop in Ben and Laura to confirm feasibility and the proposed escalation chain.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

(attachment: augmented-oncall-roster.xlsx, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T08:21:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming EU go-live — ask about response SLA for launch weekend

Kim,

Quick feasibility check from operations: we can staff the augmented cell but two constraints to confirm before committing:
- We need an agreed severity rubric (what qualifies as P1 vs P2 during launch). Suggest P1 = total service outage or >20% sustained 5m error rate; P2 = partial degradation, increased 95th latency beyond 2x baseline.
- The 15-minute acknowledgment for P1 implies immediate pager escalation; to meet that consistently we'll need to lock the roster by EOD Friday and guarantee no planned maintenance that weekend.

Commercially: Ben, will Sales take a credit-first or premium support approach here? StreamlinePay is mid-enterprise and has a committed spend; a temporary premium surcharge for the weekend is reasonable, but they may prefer credits tied to missed acknowledgments.

I'll draft the severity rubric and a short annex for the SLA amendment.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Operations, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T10:37:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming EU go-live — ask about response SLA for launch weekend

Agree with Laura. Commercial recommendation: offer two options to StreamlinePay —
A) Paid weekend premium: fixed fee of EUR 12,000 for dedicated ops cell + guaranteed P1/P2 ack targets. No automatic credits; dedicated coverage only.
B) No upfront fee: standard support but with SLA amendment that includes credits for missed acknowledgments: 25% monthly credit per missed P1 ack (capped at 100%).

I recommend pitching A first (predictable ops resourcing) and letting them pick B if they push back. I'll prepare a concise commercial note and a redlined amendment if they accept.

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor James <eleanor.james@streamlinepay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T14:08:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming EU go-live — ask about response SLA for launch weekend

Eleanor — following internal alignment, here is our formal proposal for the 72-hour launch window (2026-05-21 00:00 UTC+1 through 2026-05-23 23:59 UTC+1):

Operational commitments (temporary amendment):
- P1: acknowledgment within 15 minutes (ack = incident triage + assignment to ops cell), continuous paging until acknowledgement.
- P2: acknowledgment within 2 hours.
- Definition annex (attached): explicit thresholds for P1/P2 (total outage, error-rate thresholds, latency bands).
- Dedicated ops cell: 2 SREs + 1 Tech Lead on continuous coverage, escalation to Senior SRE on second pager.

Notification & escalation path:
- Primary channel: dedicated Slack workspace channel (private) with StreamlinePay ops and Redwood ops cell.
- PagerDuty: high-severity incidents route to on-call cell immediately.
- Secondary path: SMS escalation to ops lead; 24/7 phone bridge number for critical incidents.

Commercial options (pick one):
A) Operational premium: EUR 12,000 one-time fee for the weekend to cover dedicated resourcing.
B) Credit-based: no upfront fee; if P1 ack missed, StreamlinePay receives 25% monthly usage credit per missed P1 (capped).

Action items for StreamlinePay to finalize by EOD 2026-05-15:
1) Send expected traffic profile (peak qps + baseline) for the window.
2) Confirm primary + secondary contacts and who will be in the Slack channel.
3) Confirm choice of commercial option A or B.

If we get the above by Friday EOD we'll lock the roster and publish the temporary amendment.

Thanks — we want the launch to go smoothly and will prioritize the coverage.

Best,
Kimberly
(attachment: launch-sla-amendment-draft.docx)

From: Eleanor James <eleanor.james@streamlinepay.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: devops@streamlinepay.com
Date: 2026-05-13T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming EU go-live — ask about response SLA for launch weekend

Kimberly — thanks for the clear plan. We prefer Option A (paid premium) to avoid the uncertainty of credits.

Attached: traffic profile (estimated peak TPS 4,200, baseline 850 TPS) and primary contacts. Adding our SRE lead, Marco Rossi, to the Slack channel once you send the invite.

We agree to the severity rubric in the annex; please send the redline for signature and the PagerDuty escalation path.

— Eleanor
(attachment: streamlinepay-traffic-profile.csv)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor James <eleanor.james@streamlinepay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-15T16:42:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming EU go-live — ask about response SLA for launch weekend

Eleanor — great, thank you. Next steps we have completed or in-flight:
- Sales: Ben will issue the invoice for EUR 12,000 and include the SLA amendment for signature (DL-2026-4789).
- Ops: Laura has locked the augmented roster and shared the on-call matrix with our SREs.
- Security/comms: we will create the dedicated Slack channel and invite Marco + your primary + secondary.
- PD integration: PagerDuty escalation will be sent to the ops cell; we will share routing IDs once configured.

I'll send the final amendment and the DocuSign link by Monday EOD. Looking forward to a smooth cutover — we'll be on standby.

Best regards,
Kimberly

(related link: https://app.docusign.com/streams/streams/DL-2026-4789)
